items.prompt: Why does equal bracket counting fail to validate ([)]?

options.text: It never counts any closing bracket
options.why: Counting can be implemented but still misses order.
Equal counts do not prove the most recent opener matches.

options.text: It ignores the LIFO nesting constraint
options.why: A closing must match the latest unmatched opener.

options.text: It distinguishes proper nesting whenever each bracket kind has equal totals
options.why: Even separate totals for each kind do not encode whether a closer matches the most recent unmatched opener.

items.explanation: The unmatched-opener stack encodes nesting order, which a single balance/count cannot preserve for multiple bracket types.
